lista.titulo: Muse: Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
lista.descripcion: Rock am Ring was originally planned as a one-time festival on the Nürburgring motorsports complex but has grown into a yearly event. Muse perform their brand of rock and roll on the main stage in 2018.

lista.titulo: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
lista.descripcion: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

lista.titulo: The Black Keys: Live at Main Festival Square

lista.titulo: John Denver Rocky Mountain High Live in Japan
lista.descripcion: In this 1981 concert, the folk rock legend performs his greatest hits, including 'Annie's Song', 'Calypso' and 'Sunshine on my Shoulders'.

lista.titulo: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
lista.descripcion: Florence and the Machine perform at the Austin City Limits Music Festival, an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.
